title: Shishi
summary: Nonprofit mobile app that connects hosts, guests, and donors to organize and fund free community Shabbat dinners — host-approved sign-ups, in-app messaging, and a safety feature that hides personal details.
highlights: Host-approved sign-up flow for guests and donors
In-app messaging between hosts and guests
Safety feature that hides personal details until approved

title: Outpost
summary: Fashion platform with taste-aware product recommendations — compares prices across 18+ retailers and alerts users to price drops. Built a "Product DNA" tagging system over a catalog of ~8,000 products.

title: Recruiting OS
summary: Near zero-touch recruiting operating system for a job search — a Notion-backed contact CRM and application tracker with a React dashboard, plus AI pipelines that watch Gmail for recruiting emails and auto-extract contacts, applications, and interview events with Claude.
highlights: Notion-backed contact CRM with interaction history and a referral graph
AI email pipeline (Gmail + Claude) that auto-creates contacts, applications, and calendar events
Call-summary extraction into structured Notion records

title: Course Signal
summary: Advisor-facing course-planning signal built from historical enrollment data — configurable per institution, with UIUC as the live demo adapter.
highlights: Portable adapter pattern for adding new schools
Scoped explicitly as a planning signal, not a capacity forecast

title: kitCreator
summary: Turns any song into a playable multi-octave sampler kit — separates stems, denoises, and slices hits into velocity-layered SFZ/DecentSampler presets for drums, bass, guitar, piano, and synth.
highlights: Source separation via Demucs, denoising via DeepFilterNet3
Automatic drum sub-stem splitting (kick/snare/hi-hat/toms/cymbals) via LarsNet
Outputs ready-to-load SFZ and DecentSampler presets
